scenario: Build passes, so mark whole subsystem PASS.
why_wrong: Build only proves compilation/build gate, not requirements/runtime/evidence.
correct_behavior: Keep requirement verdict NOT_EVALUATED until required tests/evidence run.

scenario: Use E04 report from older commit as proof for current HEAD.
why_wrong: Artifact commit differs from current HEAD.

scenario: SWARM majority says output is correct, bypass JUDGE/LAW.
why_wrong: SWARM is candidate-only and majority is not final authority.

scenario: Set DB runState directly from READY to STABLE.
correct_behavior: Use legal transition sequence and authority.

scenario: Source mentions Robotics, therefore DOC-C must implement Robotics now.
wrong_behavior: Mark DOC-C FAIL for missing robotics
why_wrong: Robotics is future architecture unless promoted.

scenario: Backend FREEZE but UI shows successful completion animation.
Redis unavailable; silently switch to insecure fail-open in production.
why_wrong: Default policy is fail-closed; hidden fallback weakens abuse controls.
correct_behavior: Block/degrade or use explicitly configured dev/test fail-open.

scenario: Canonical Core uses Date.now/random/float to decide authoritative state.
why_wrong: Core determinism law excludes system clock/RNG/FP.
correct_behavior: Use locked deterministic inputs or freeze.

scenario: Lo2 deletes old verified rule because new candidate looks better.
A test file exists in repo, therefore requirement is proven.
why_wrong: File presence does not prove execution/result.
correct_behavior: Test link only; execution UNKNOWN until exact-head evidence.

scenario: Call buildFreezeEnvelope and assume incident/audit persisted.
